selection: Retrospective use of all 72 delivered points and eight delivery absences from the previous fixed 80-treatment study. Deduplication yields 41 complete integer vectors, 12 in nive. No new MIP models or native MIP solves. Generalization to other archived models is not new prospective family validation.
construction_correction_before_first_cal: A certificate test exposed overwritten lambda-bound coefficients when their budget weight was zero. The original design and pre-solve correction are retained. No LP result existed at the correction; treatment selection and parameters were unchanged.
conditional_thresholds: After the 178 characterization tasks, the predeclared rule selected the ten certified feasible nive patterns for cost-threshold and safe-factor checks. Two infeasible patterns were retained and excluded from a v(0)-based loss measure by definition.
selective_extension: A separate post-observation protocol and source-hashed design were frozen before ten selective-budget LP calls. The later row-only allocation is rational analysis using existing duals and primals, with zero additional native calls; it supplies a sufficient cost bound rather than a new selective LP optimum.
solver_failure: One feasibility-threshold LP returned a SoPlex numerical error and no rational certificate. Its zero threshold is proved separately from the already certified v(0) primal and the lambda>=0 row. The native failure is retained as unverified, not reclassified as a solver success or retried.
numeric_representation: Original model coefficients/RHS/costs/bounds use archived canonical binary64 rationals. Dyadic lambda values and complete decimal export avoid additional input rounding. The objective threshold is rounded upward to a multiple of 2^-40; exact before/after values are retained and checked. Nive original MPS literals are all exact in binary64, while its numerical budgets such as 1e-4 have explicitly binary64 rational interpretation.
policy_comparison: Replay of stored points, not an end-to-end solver timing experiment. Cost filtering and exact repair share the same pattern cache and LP witnesses. Acquisition time is measured on new fixed-pattern LP calls and charged once per cache miss. Fewer changed deliveries do not imply fewer solver calls or superior global solution quality.
guarantee: U<=C+epsilon certifies an exactly feasible continuation for the returned integer assignment with cost at most nominal plus epsilon. The error cap is unilateral and experimental; it does not bound excess cost or global MILP gap. Budget assignments are specific to audited patterns, not unknown future integers.
timing: 2-second native LP limit and 4-second watchdog; all attempts retained. Full LP task times include construction, export, solver process and proof checks. Shared preparation, replay, source acquisition and documents are separate. The previous 16-LP cost is not extrapolated to larger models.
paper: OMS v1.3.5 and all prior research packages are unchanged. No novelty is claimed for LP duality, perturbation, rational repair or Farkas. The present results do not establish a stronger algorithm than exact repair at comparable cost.
